title: Uploaded audio renewal follow-up into real HubSpot
breadth_reason: state/stranger_breadth.json has no passing hard categories yet, so this run starts CRM breadth with a concrete HubSpot user surface.

v7_target.engine: public downloadable user-device engine installed on the signed-in user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: use the user's actual visible Chrome profile and HubSpot CRM surface; do not use cloned Chrome, copied profiles, hidden browser state, private install paths, or log-only proof
v7_target.proof_rule: every action, ask, or decline must cite current surface-readable proof from the public build and the visible user surface

primary_user_input.reason: state/last_v6_transcript_audit.json is no_data, so this script forces uploaded audio ASR coverage on the same post-ASR inference pipeline.

real_user_surfaces.name: Anticipy public app
proof_needed: current public app URL or visible app state
paired installed user-device engine status if available

real_user_surfaces.name: HubSpot CRM
real_user_surfaces.surface: HubSpot CRM in the user's actual signed-in Chrome profile
proof_needed: visible Chrome URL/title or DOM/screenshot showing app.hubspot.com, a HubSpot sign-in screen, or a current HubSpot contact/deal page
surface-readable evidence for Nora Vega, Alder Works, or the absence of a matching readable record
before/after proof if Anticipy creates a HubSpot task or note

moments.instruction: Start from the public app path, use the public account/onboarding/download flow if needed, and confirm the installed user-device engine is the runtime handling the input.
proof_expected: installed user-device engine pairing or status surface
current build or installer identity when surfaced by the product

moments.surface: HubSpot CRM in real visible Chrome
moments.instruction: Attach to or open the user's actual Chrome profile with session preservation and inspect only the visible HubSpot CRM state. If HubSpot is not signed in or the matching contact/deal is not readable, leave the CRM unchanged and require Anticipy to ask or decline with that surface proof.
valid_surface_examples: app.hubspot.com contact or deal record already visible in Chrome
HubSpot sign-in screen visible in Chrome
HubSpot search results or empty-state page visible in Chrome
invalid_surface_examples: service response without a visible CRM surface

moments.spoken_reference_text: After my renewal call with Nora Vega at Alder Works, add a follow-up in HubSpot for Friday morning saying I promised to send the SOC 2 renewal summary and ask whether finance needs the vendor packet. Use the visible HubSpot contact or deal if it is already signed in. If you cannot verify the real HubSpot surface, ask me before doing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: Deliver this as uploaded audio through the product upload path. Generate a per-run audio artifact from spoken_reference_text only if no audio_path is provided. Do not use transcript paste or start live microphone capture for this primary input.
proof_expected: audio upload route receives real audio bytes
fresh upload-asr ingest id or equivalent uploaded-audio ASR receipt
observed ASR transcript and WER-scored transcript_quality.json
normalized input record with source_mode audio_upload and source_detail mp3

moments.instruction: Show that the uploaded-audio ASR transcript enters the same normalized inference boundary used by transcript upload, computer microphone, and external microphone inputs.
proof_expected: anticipy.normalized_input.v7 or equivalent normalized input artifact
same downstream inference event shape as non-audio input modes
no separate CRM decision branch for MP3 upload

moments.instruction: Choose exactly one decision after reading the uploaded-audio transcript and the real HubSpot surface.

acceptable_outcomes.when: A real visible HubSpot contact or deal for Nora Vega or Alder Works is already signed in and the product can safely create a follow-up task or note.
required_proof: task or note creation surface after action
decision artifact tied to the uploaded-audio normalized input

acceptable_outcomes.when: HubSpot is signed in but the target record or Friday timing needs confirmation.
required_proof: visible HubSpot ambiguity or missing target evidence

acceptable_outcomes.when: HubSpot is not signed in, the surface is unreadable, permissions are missing, or the product cannot verify it is using the real Chrome user surface.
required_proof: visible HubSpot sign-in, missing permission, or unreadable-surface evidence

unacceptable_outcomes: creating a CRM result without a current HubSpot visible surface
using transcript paste as the delivered primary input
using live microphone permission as a prerequisite for uploaded audio
acting in a non-HubSpot note surface for the CRM hard category

moments.instruction: After the primary uploaded-audio path is delivered, observe whether the public product exposes transcript upload, computer microphone, and external microphone selection controls. Record gaps, but do not replace the uploaded-audio input with those modes.
proof_expected: visible transcript upload or paste control if present
visible computer microphone permission or selected-device state if present
visible external microphone selection or missing-device state if present

success_criteria: persona_uuid matches the UUID directory and persona.json uuid
uploaded audio is the delivered primary input
a fresh uploaded-audio ASR transcript reaches the same post-ASR inference pipeline
HubSpot CRM is the hard-category surface and is read through real visible Chrome
Anticipy records act, ask, or decline with surface-readable proof from the current public build
failure_triggers: primary input is transcript paste, paste-only, live mic, or microphone permission dependent
no upload_audio moment with input_fidelity uploaded_audio is exercised
HubSpot CRM proof is replaced by a generic browser note or non-user surface
Chrome proof comes from a cloned profile or hidden browser
decision proof relies on logs without visible surface evidence
product uses a private build or source checkout as the user-device engine
